decisions.root_cause: The ticket combines suite execution, completion publication, and persistent repair accounting without defining their trust and transaction boundaries. Publishing from the still-running suite cannot prove workflow completion; mutable issue markers cannot establish lineage or retry authority; branch-only tests cannot exercise a workflow_run listener before it exists on the default branch. This is a planning conflict, not a code failure.
evidence: Verified clean worktree HEAD a75002cec2290f3e510af78fcec1ba36b5a25bc4. Against a65f7087bd72ac2b2f6b8378dc552e82dab37d23, the only change is manifest bookkeeping: W11-008 Done evidence and W11-010 Ready. No implementation or failure artifact exists; the supplied escalation packet explicitly reports no CI run, failing command, or attempted repair.

Read AGENTS.md, WORKFLOW.md, the complete port plan and manifest, .codex/config.toml, and windows-arbitrator.toml. W11-010 requires authoritative post-merge Layer A and active deduplication; W11-011 owns live Layer B activation. The manifest remains authoritative for retry and arbitration state.

ci.yml contains the full Windows/macOS matrix, package verification, and fail-closed aggregate gate. It is not reusable. tests/test_platform_ci.py asserts its concrete layout. Existing pytest tests discovery includes the proposed integration tests.

GitHub documents workflow_run completion triggers, default-branch availability, privileged execution, and a three-level chaining limit. A same-name listener introduces avoidable self-triggering; a skipped job does not change the listener's event subscription. Use a separate finalizer. [GitHub events](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows#workflow_run)

Authenticated workflow-run reads use actions:read; suite-provider verification uses checks:read; commit-to-PR association uses pull-requests:read. These are distinct permissions. [Workflow runs](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs#get-a-workflow-run), [Check suites](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/checks/suites#get-a-check-suite), [Commit PR associations](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/commits/commits#list-pull-requests-associated-with-a-commit)

Job-specific permissions support isolating issue writes. Default concurrency can replace pending runs, so serialization alone is not durable event processing. [Permissions](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#permissions), [Concurrency](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-when-workflows-run/control-workflow-concurrency)
directed_repair: Keep post-merge.yml as the trusted push-to-develop full-suite producer with contents:read only. Copy the existing CI jobs without changing their commands, action pins, runners, matrix, stage, or gate semantics. Add a parity test comparing the complete copied jobs and relevant environment against ci.yml; allow only explicitly enumerated reporting differences. Leave ci.yml and tests/test_platform_ci.py unchanged. A reusable-CI refactor is unnecessary for this ticket.

Add post-merge-finalize.yml with a distinct workflow name, listening only to completed runs of the producer on develop. Do not use the proposed same-file, self-name workflow_run listener. Add a trusted develop-only manual reconciliation mode for recovery. Neither workflow accepts PR-triggered publication or executes on a self-hosted runner.

Implement tools/post_merge_publisher.py using the existing Python runtime and standard library, separating GitHub transport from the state reducer. Before publication, re-fetch the source run and verify repository identity, workflow ID resolved from post-merge.yml, workflow path, event=push, head_branch=develop, completed status, source SHA, and current run attempt. Verify the linked check suite belongs to that SHA and the GitHub Actions app. Fetch all required jobs with pagination; require all three Layer A results and required / gate to succeed. The source run's SHA is authoritative, never the finalizer's github.sha.

Give only the finalizer publication job contents:read, actions:read, checks:read, pull-requests:read, and issues:write; all other scopes remain none. actions:read supports runs/jobs/logs, checks:read verifies the suite app, and pull-requests:read identifies the merged PR introducing the exact commit. This narrowly documented read expansion resolves AC4 while preserving its sole write scope. It authorizes no PAT, settings change, secret creation, shared runtime, contents write, or Actions write. If the effective token cannot perform these operations, block publication as an external permission failure and request human direction.

Resolve ticket and repair lineage from controller-owned metadata committed through protected develop, including originating ticket, associated PR number, repair issue ID when registered, and predecessor repair relationship. Cross-check PR association through GitHub: merged, base develop, and merge_commit_sha equal to the source commit. Use PR bodies and issue markers only as discovery hints. Missing or ambiguous lineage produces an explicit blocked diagnostic, never a guessed ticket or retry reset.

Treat issue bodies, labels, and comments as editable projections, not an immutable ledger. Reconstruct conclusions and failure counts from verified GitHub runs plus protected lineage metadata. Search all open and closed repair issues with pagination before creating one; validate candidate creator and referenced run/commit/lineage. On ambiguous duplicates or missing retained provenance, block instead of creating another issue or trusting a stored counter. After an uncertain create response, reconcile by reading before retrying. Persist the resulting issue ID through controller bookkeeping.

Serialize publisher mutations with one repository-specific finalizer concurrency group and cancel-in-progress:false. Each invocation reconciles all outstanding registered lineage runs, rather than only its triggering event, so replaced pending invocations do not lose evidence. Order commits by verified lineage, not delivery time. Immediately before publication, re-read the latest relevant merged commit and latest run attempt; retain older results as historical evidence without letting them close a newer repair or reset its counter. The controller must revalidate that same target before consuming a Done projection or dispatching work.

Publish exact-SHA completion evidence containing repository, ticket/lineage, merged PR, workflow ID/path, run ID/attempt/URL, check-suite ID/app, required job conclusions, and finalizer run URL. The controller alone applies the authoritative manifest Merged-to-Done transition after independently validating publication and the completion profile. A failed finalizer leaves completion pending even when the producer passed. W11-011/W11-012 cannot become Done from Layer A alone.

For a code-attributable failure, create/update one repair issue per originating ticket and layer lineage, recording failing commit, source run/attempt, failed job/step and available test identifiers, exact associated merged PR, and a proposed protected-PR revert hint. Deduplicate repeated observations by source run/attempt and repeated failures by remediation commit/signature; reruns do not consume another code retry. Reset consecutive failures only on a complete pass at the latest relevant lineage commit. Unknown or infrastructure failures remain blocked without invented code attribution. At failures three and four, publish Blocked/arbitration-requested and Blocked/needs-human respectively; only the controller dispatches the arbitrator or worker.

Before merge, exercise the actual publisher entrypoint and HTTP transport against a local fake GitHub server inside the existing PR tests: PASS, FAIL, rerun, stale PASS after newer failure, concurrent reconciliation, edited markers, partial API failure, pagination, and wrong workflow/repository/provider. These tests are executable publisher tests but are not evidence of live GitHub issue writes or workflow_run delivery.

After protected merge, require the real post-merge.yml push run on W11-010's exact merged SHA and successful finalizer reconciliation. Also run a develop-only manual acceptance mode executing the same publisher against GitHub issues with a hardcoded isolated W11-010 simulation namespace: simulated PASS, FAIL, and rerun across separate invocations, asserting one repair issue and unchanged retry count on rerun. Label all such evidence simulated; it must never update production ticket state or count as genuine suite PASS/FAIL. Record run URLs and read-back issue IDs. This proves live publication and persistence without deliberately breaking develop. Keep W11-010 Merged until both real completion and simulation evidence exist.

Implement windows11-integration.yml as an inactive trusted manual/reusable path. Gate before allocating self-hosted resources; reject PR/merge_group callers and arbitrary unmerged refs, require an exact protected develop commit and the separately recorded hardware authorization. Do not invoke it during W11-010 acceptance. Hardware-free tests must cover production command-to-transform wiring, bounded polling, baseline restoration in finally, separate cleanup failure reporting, and serialized OBS access without cancelling active cleanup.

decisions.root_cause: The original permission baseline omits reads needed to verify authoritative completion and associate an exact merged commit with its PR. An artifact-only substitute would weaken acceptance. The clean worker escalation confirms this remains a design conflict with zero code failures.
evidence: a75002cec2290f3e510af78fcec1ba36b5a25bc4 is a local, unpushed tracker commit, not remote execution evidence. Reject the worker's constructed GitHub link and truncated SHA as provenance.
The earlier read-only inspection found a clean worktree and only tracker changes against a65f7087bd72ac2b2f6b8378dc552e82dab37d23. The worker now independently confirms no edits.

The associated-PR endpoint requires pull-requests:read for authenticated fine-grained access. [GitHub commit API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/commits/commits#list-pull-requests-associated-with-a-commit)
W11-010 requires exact merged-SHA post-merge completion evidence and demonstrated repair deduplication; local artifacts alone do not satisfy that contract.
directed_repair: Retain the previous separate producer/finalizer architecture and full completion contract. post-merge.yml runs the complete suite on trusted develop pushes; post-merge-finalize.yml validates the completed source run and publishes evidence. Do not replace verification or issue publication with an artifact-only contract.

Document finalizer-only permissions explicitly: contents:read for protected source and lineage metadata; actions:read for workflow runs, attempts, jobs and logs; checks:read for check-suite app/SHA verification; pull-requests:read for exact-commit merged-PR association; issues:write for repair publication. All other permissions remain none. Producer and PR jobs retain contents:read only.

Treat this as a targeted repository-workflow read-permission expansion, not approval for external settings, PATs, new secrets, shared runtimes, or live OBS. Verify effective permissions during trusted acceptance. A denial blocks the external operation without consuming code retries; do not substitute credentials or weaken evidence.

Before merge, run the actual publisher against a fake GitHub HTTP server through branch/PR CI with read-only permissions. Exercise PASS, FAIL and rerun plus provenance, stale-result and deduplication failures. Record these as simulated transport tests, not live issue-publication or workflow_run evidence.

After protected merge makes the finalizer available on the default branch, require the genuine full-suite push result and finalizer evidence on the exact merged W11-010 SHA. Then use the documented develop-only manual acceptance mode for isolated simulated PASS, FAIL and rerun publication through the real issue API. Execute only protected code; use a fixed simulation namespace, prohibit production status/retry mutations, and record real run URLs and issue read-backs.

The controller executes those acceptance runs within the existing W11-010 delivery authorization; this arbitration performs no external writes. If existing noninteractive authority cannot dispatch or publish, report that specific missing capability for human action. Do not grant actions:write to the publisher merely to launch its own tests.

Keep W11-010 Merged until genuine exact-SHA completion and live simulation/deduplication evidence are both present. The controller records authoritative manifest transitions; Luna implements the directed repair.
